about: The secreta of the formulary “Most Holy Name of Jesus” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May Thy blessing, most merciful God, by which every creature liveth, sanctify, we beseech Thee, this sacrifice of ours which we offer unto Thee for the glory of the name of Thy Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, that it may be pleasing to Thy majesty unto praise and profit us unto salvation. Through the same our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
